ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) with approximately 10% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel coverage from scratching and stippling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density white stippling across the right lobe; prominent horizontal white linear streaks on the left lobe; irregular light-grey mottled patch centered around the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with an approximate 55-degree angle; depth extends roughly 15% into the vertical span of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern; peak-to-valley amplitudes range from 5 to 25 pixels; approximately 25 distinct peaks per lobe boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex curve from the peduncle base transitioning into a sharp upward concave sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of golden-brown and white circular barnacles localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; secondary clusters visible along the upper trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three prominent horizontal linear white streaks on the left lobe; multiple smaller, multi-directional scratches scattered throughout the ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) on the left lobe; heavy epibiotic barnacle colonization on distal margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'starfield' pattern of small white stippled dots concentrated heavily on the right lobe surface.
